## Selected open-source projects

### RouteMind AI
Shipment planning with LangGraph, PydanticAI, FastAPI, and Chroma. Validates multi-leg routing constraints and asks for missing parameters before generating a plan.
Stack: LangGraph, PydanticAI, FastAPI, Chroma, PostgreSQL.
Architecture: Shipment request → Typed extraction → LangGraph orchestration → Hybrid evidence retrieval → Deterministic optimizer → Verified plan + citations.
Scope: Uses synthetic carriers, schedules, and prices. Supports planning and comparison; does not book shipments or return live freight quotes.
Case study: https://chetsp.github.io/chetanapatel.github.io/work/routemind-ai/
Repository: https://github.com/chetsp/RouteMind-AI

### Gita Guru
A multilingual learning web app using Claude and JavaScript for explanations across 26+ languages, with browser-native audio narration through the Web Speech API.
Stack: JavaScript, Claude, Web Speech API, HTML / CSS.
Architecture: Chapter + verse selection → Claude explanations → Translated story panels → Web Speech narration → Session progress.
Scope: The browser uses speech synthesis for narration and sessionStorage for progress. Public hosting requires a server-side proxy for provider credentials.
Case study: https://chetsp.github.io/chetanapatel.github.io/work/gita-guru/
Repository: https://github.com/chetsp/Gita-Guru

### Survey Application Modernization
Converted a static Figma design system into a full-CRUD application using React, TypeScript, Tailwind, and FastAPI, including form validation and persistent storage.
Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind, FastAPI, SQLite.
Architecture: Figma Make design → React + Tailwind → Form validation → FastAPI endpoints → SQLModel + SQLite.
Scope: University project covering design-system implementation, client-side validation, routing, and CRUD integration.
Case study: https://chetsp.github.io/chetanapatel.github.io/work/ai-modernization/
Repository: https://github.com/chetsp/AI-Modernization
